description: Groups multiple security profiles into a single object referenced by Security Policy rules.

name.description: Name of the security profile group. Use alphanumeric characters and hyphens; will be normalized to snake_case for Terraform labels.

description.description: Optional description of this profile group.

scope_type.description: Whether this object lives in a VSYS (standalone firewall) or Device Group (Panorama-managed).

vsys.description: The virtual system to assign this object to.

device_group.description: The Panorama device group to assign this object to.

antivirus.description: Reference to an Antivirus security profile. Leave blank to skip antivirus inspection.

anti_spyware.description: Reference to an Anti-Spyware security profile. Leave blank to skip anti-spyware inspection.

vulnerability.description: Reference to a Vulnerability protection profile. Leave blank to skip vulnerability inspection.

url_filtering.description: Reference to a URL Filtering profile. Leave blank to skip URL filtering.

wildfire_analysis.description: Reference to a WildFire Analysis profile. Leave blank to skip WildFire analysis.

file_blocking.description: Reference to a File Blocking profile. Leave blank to skip file blocking.

data_filtering.description: Reference to a Data Filtering profile. Leave blank to skip data filtering.

dns_security.description: Reference to a DNS Security profile. Leave blank to skip DNS security inspection.
